extraction.outputs: Checks and bounded stdout are copied from the redacted source report. Native stderr is omitted. RPC results are represented by the original successful check receipts; no response body is invented.
extraction.paths: Original report placeholders <TEMP_ROOT>/<CLIENT_BIN>/<HOST_HOME> are retained. Entry digests identify only the recorded entry file; package integrity and lock digests remain separate.
